title: 实验室里的安全
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/03_Safety in laboratory.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/03_Safety in laboratory/src.py

points.K1: 本课是提示，系统学习要上安全课
points.K2: 科研实验常新，风险要主动找
points.K3: 安全关系人、设备和实验
points.K13: 近视眼镜不是安全眼镜
points.K14: 安全眼镜：四周遮挡，可罩眼镜
points.K17: 普通口罩够不够，先确认
points.K21: 手套尺寸和厚度要合适
points.K26: 装了减压阀，更不能不固定
points.K28: 实验室不留未固定的气瓶

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，身后是一排实验台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab doorway with rows of lab benches behind it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识实验室里的五类危险源。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶、插座、水龙头、气瓶、加热炉五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a reagent bottle, a wall socket, a water tap, a gas cylinder and a furnace. No people.
shots.narration: 再学会穿戴防护，管好气瓶。

shots.scene: 阿杰刚搭好一套新装置，满意地拍手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student claps his hands, pleased with a new experimental setup of tubing and a small furnace on a bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰搭了套新装置，准备马上开干。

shots.scene: 阿杰只戴着自己的近视眼镜，旁边的气瓶没有固定
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears only his everyday prescription glasses; a gas cylinder with a regulator stands loose beside the bench.
shots.narration: 眼镜是近视镜，气瓶也没拴。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指了指气瓶和他的眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points at the loose gas cylinder, then at his glasses.
shots.narration: 小研摇摇头：先别急，看看哪里有危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前举起一个放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a magnifying glass in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 新实验，最需要先把危险找出来。

shots.section_title: 本课是提示，系统学习要上安全课
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白小册子，旁边是一摞厚厚的空白教材
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thin blank booklet next to a tall stack of thick blank textbooks.
shots.narration: 安全是个大题目，这一课只讲要点。
overlay: 本课是提示，系统学习要上安全课

shots.section_title: 本课是提示，系统学习要上安全课
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室里给学生上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 想学全，要参加专门的安全课程。

shots.section_title: 科研实验常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 工厂流水线上，工人按固定步骤操作的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a factory production line where each station repeats the same fixed step. No people.
shots.narration: 工厂里，每个岗位天天做同样的事。
overlay: 科研实验常新，风险要主动找

shots.section_title: 科研实验常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 流水线旁的规程本和固定防护用品图标
shots.prompt_en: A fixed procedure book and a set of protective gear icons placed beside each factory station. No people.
shots.narration: 规程固定，防护也早就配好。

shots.section_title: 科研实验常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 实验台上的装置不断变化，问号接连冒出
shots.prompt_en: On a lab bench, an experimental setup changes shape again and again while question marks pop up above it. No people.
shots.narration: 科研不一样：新实验、新装置不断出现。

shots.section_title: 科研实验常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 小研拿着放大镜检查新装置的每个连接处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks each joint of a new setup with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 所以要主动去想：哪一步要格外小心。

shots.section_title: 安全关系人、设备和实验
shots.scene: 人、仪器、样品三个图标被一把保护伞罩住
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a person, an instrument and a sample flask, sheltered under one umbrella. No people.
shots.narration: 安全护的是人，也护设备和实验。
overlay: 安全关系人、设备和实验

shots.section_title: 安全关系人、设备和实验
shots.scene: 实验室里几个人各自做实验，互相能看到
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student work at nearby benches in the same lab.
shots.narration: 实验室里的每个人，都和你有关。

shots.scene: 一棵小树苗慢慢长成大树
shots.prompt_en: A small seedling grows step by step into a sturdy tree, with a shield icon on its trunk. No people.
shots.narration: 安全是一种文化，不是一夜养成。

shots.scene: 一张规程清单旁边，一个人主动举手提醒同伴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to remind the young male student of something next to a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 不只照着条文做，更要亲自参与。

shots.scene: 试剂架上一排空白标签的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of reagent bottles with blank labels in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类危险源：化学品。

shots.scene: 酸、碱、粉末、生物样品四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: an acid bottle, a base bottle, a powder jar and a sample tube with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 酸、碱、粉末，还有生物样品。

shots.scene: 一本空白规程书压在试剂瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure book placed next to the reagent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 它们都要按规范来拿取和保管。

shots.scene: 墙上的插座面板和配电箱
shots.prompt_en: A wall with socket panels and a closed electrical distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类：电，哪个实验室都离不开。

shots.scene: 灯、风扇、温控器、仪器四个图标连到同一个插头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a light bulb, a fan, a thermostat and an instrument all connected to one plug. No people.
shots.narration: 照明、风扇、温控、仪器都要用电。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着插座，头上冒出警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a wall socket with a yellow warning triangle above it.
shots.narration: 天天见，反而最容易被忽视。

shots.scene: 实验室水槽，龙头流水
shots.prompt_en: A lab sink with water running from the tap. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类：水，几乎每个实验室都有水槽。

shots.scene: 水槽里洗玻璃器皿和洗手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: glassware being washed in a sink and hands being washed. No people.
shots.narration: 洗器皿、洗手，都在这里。

shots.scene: 墙边立着装有减压阀的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder with a pressure regulator stands against a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类：气瓶。

shots.scene: 实验装置通过管道连到几只不同的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A small tube furnace connected by tubing to several blank gas cylinders. No people.
shots.narration: 很多实验要用气体来控制气氛。

shots.scene: 气瓶剖面图里挤满了压缩的气体分子
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a gas cylinder packed with tightly compressed gas particles and a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶里是高压气体，必须规范处理。

shots.scene: 电热板、烘箱、高温炉三个图标，都带热浪线
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with heat waves: a hot plate, a drying oven and a furnace. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类：热源。

shots.scene: 箱式炉、管式炉、立式炉几种外形
shots.prompt_en: Several furnace shapes side by side: a box furnace, a horizontal tube furnace and a vertical furnace. No people.
shots.narration: 高温炉有箱式、管式，有立有卧。

shots.scene: 温度计图标一路升到很高
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon rising very high, glowing red at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 炉温能到一千多摄氏度，要格外小心。

shots.scene: 小研进门后先从挂钩上取下实验服穿上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student enters the lab and takes a lab coat from a hook and puts it on.
shots.narration: 先说穿戴：一进实验室，就穿实验服。

shots.scene: 液滴溅在实验服袖子上，没有碰到皮肤
shots.prompt_en: Small droplets splash onto the sleeve of a buttoned lab coat and do not reach the skin. No people.
shots.narration: 溅出的液滴，先落在实验服上。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着实验服、手套、护目镜，旁边是一枚小硬币
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a lab coat, gloves and goggles beside a small coin icon.
shots.narration: 防护用品不贵，却能大大提高安全。

shots.scene: 小研戴上一副蓝色丁腈手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls on a pair of blue nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 第二件：手套。

shots.scene: 皮肤像一面盾牌，手套又加了一层
shots.prompt_en: An icon of skin drawn as a shield, then a glove layer added on top as a second shield. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤是第一道屏障，手套再加一层。

shots.scene: 样品瓶上一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A sample jar with a big question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 样品毒不毒，常常说不清。

shots.scene: 小研戴着薄手套灵活地拧开小瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing thin nitrile gloves, easily unscrews a small vial cap.
shots.narration: 养成戴手套的习惯，薄手套也不碍事。

shots.scene: 几种手套和几种溶剂瓶之间连线，有的打勾有的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Several glove icons linked by lines to several solvent bottles with blank labels, some links with green checks and some with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 手套不是万能的。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白的手套耐受表选手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares gloves against a blank glove compatibility chart.
shots.narration: 先查它耐哪些溶剂，再选用。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不是安全眼镜
shots.scene: 阿杰指着自己的近视眼镜，一脸自信
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at his everyday prescription glasses with a confident smile.
shots.narration: 阿杰以为：戴着眼镜就够了。
overlay: 近视眼镜不是安全眼镜

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不是安全眼镜
shots.scene: 普通眼镜侧面、上方、下方的空隙被箭头标出
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show the open gaps at the sides, top and bottom of ordinary glasses. No people.
shots.narration: 普通眼镜，四周都是空的。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不是安全眼镜
shots.scene: 飞溅液滴从眼镜侧面绕进去的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a splash curving around the side of ordinary glasses toward the eye, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液体一溅，就可能从缝里进眼。

shots.section_title: 近视眼镜不是安全眼镜
shots.scene: 普通镜片被撞碎成许多碎片的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ordinary lens shattering into many pieces after being hit, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 普通镜片还不防碎，碎了更伤眼。

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜：四周遮挡，可罩眼镜
shots.scene: 四周包住的护目镜，四个方向都有勾
shots.prompt_en: Safety goggles with side, top and bottom shields, with green checks on all four sides. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜四周都有遮挡，镜片防碎。
overlay: 安全眼镜：四周遮挡，可罩眼镜

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜：四周遮挡，可罩眼镜
shots.scene: 阿杰把护目镜罩在近视眼镜外面戴好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts safety goggles on over his prescription glasses.
shots.narration: 尺寸偏大，正好罩在近视眼镜外面。

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜：四周遮挡，可罩眼镜
shots.scene: 护目镜边缘的小透气孔，空气流动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of goggles with small vents along the frame and little airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 嫌闷热，可以选带透气结构的款式。

shots.scene: 锤子敲钉子，钉子弹飞的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hammer hitting a nail that bounces off and flies toward a face outline. No people.
shots.narration: 护眼不只为了化学品。

shots.scene: 老李戴着护目镜在墙上钉钉子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears safety goggles while hammering a nail into a wall.
shots.narration: 钉个钉子，钉子也会弹飞伤眼。

shots.scene: 护目镜和一枚小硬币放在天平两端，护目镜一端更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a small coin on one side and safety goggles on the other, tipping toward the goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 花钱不多，护住的是一双眼睛。

shots.scene: 桌上一筐防护用品：护目镜、遮光护目镜、面屏
shots.prompt_en: A tray on a table holding clear goggles, tinted shaded goggles and a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 眼面防护有好几种。

shots.scene: 遮光护目镜挡住一束强光
shots.prompt_en: Tinted goggles block a bright glare of light coming from a glowing furnace opening. No people.
shots.narration: 有强光，选带遮光的护目镜。

shots.scene: 小研戴面屏，面屏下仍戴着护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a face shield over her safety goggles.
shots.narration: 面屏能护住更大面积的脸。

shots.section_title: 普通口罩够不够，先确认
shots.scene: 一只普通外科式口罩，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A plain surgical style face mask with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 粉尘多的实验，还要护住呼吸。
overlay: 普通口罩够不够，先确认

shots.section_title: 普通口罩够不够，先确认
shots.scene: 粗颗粒被挡住，细小颗粒穿过口罩的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plain mask stopping large particles while tiny particles pass through it. No people.
shots.narration: 普通口罩，有的样品挡得住，有的挡不住。

shots.section_title: 普通口罩够不够，先确认
shots.scene: 小研查看空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet at a desk.
shots.narration: 够不够用，要先查清楚再决定。

shots.scene: 带两只滤盒的半面罩呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: A half-face respirator with two replaceable filter cartridges, shown on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 更好的选择，是带滤芯的呼吸器。

shots.scene: 空气经过滤芯变干净再进入口鼻的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of air passing through a filter cartridge, turning clean before reaching the nose and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 罩住口鼻，吸进的空气都经过过滤。

shots.scene: 几种不同颜色、空白标签的滤芯
shots.prompt_en: Several filter cartridges in different colors with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 滤芯按粉尘或化学物质来选。

shots.scene: 老周戴着厚隔热手套，用坩埚钳从炉口取坩埚
shots.prompt_en: The older man wears thick heat-resistant gloves and lifts a crucible from a furnace opening with long tongs.
shots.narration: 拿热的样品和工具，戴隔热手套。

shots.scene: 徒手去拿热坩埚的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand reaching for a glowing hot crucible, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别徒手去碰热的东西。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴隔热手套练习夹取，有点笨拙
shots.prompt_en: The young male student practices gripping with tongs while wearing bulky heat-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 隔热手套有点笨重，多练就习惯了。

shots.scene: 隔热手套挂在高温炉旁的挂钩上
shots.prompt_en: Heat-resistant gloves hang on a hook next to a furnace. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里要常备，伸手就能拿到。

shots.scene: 一副长袖橙色耐酸手套
shots.prompt_en: A pair of long-cuff orange acid-resistant rubber gloves on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 处理酸，选耐酸手套。

shots.scene: 酸滴落在耐酸手套上被挡住
shots.prompt_en: Acid drops land on an orange acid-resistant glove and bead off without soaking through. No people.
shots.narration: 它比普通手套更能挡住酸液。

shots.section_title: 手套尺寸和厚度要合适
shots.scene: 几盒不同尺码、不同厚度的丁腈手套
shots.prompt_en: Several boxes of nitrile gloves in different sizes and thicknesses, with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 丁腈手套也有不同尺寸和厚度。
overlay: 手套尺寸和厚度要合适

shots.section_title: 手套尺寸和厚度要合适
shots.scene: 太大太松的手套被打叉，贴合的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a loose oversized glove crossed out with a red X and a well-fitting glove with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 选合手的，太松太紧都不好。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现手、鼻子、眼睛、身体四个防护图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons: a gloved hand, a respirator, goggles and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 手套护手，口罩和呼吸器护呼吸。

shots.scene: 小研全套穿戴整齐站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a bench in a buttoned lab coat, goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 护目镜面屏护眼，实验服护全身。

shots.scene: 气瓶瓶颈和减压阀特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the neck of a gas cylinder with a pressure regulator attached. No people.
shots.narration: 再说气瓶：减压阀装在瓶颈上。

shots.scene: 瓶颈处出现裂纹的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram highlighting the narrow neck of a cylinder with a small crack line at the valve. No people.
shots.narration: 瓶颈是最脆弱的地方。

shots.scene: 气瓶倒地、瓶颈断开、气流喷出的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder falling over with its neck snapping and a gas jet bursting out, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶一倒，瓶颈可能折断。

shots.scene: 喷气的气瓶像火箭一样乱窜的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a broken cylinder shooting across a room like a rocket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 高压气体失控喷出，非常危险。

shots.scene: 气瓶被链条拴在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder secured to a wall bracket with a chain. No people.
shots.narration: 所以，气瓶必须固定，不能倾倒。

shots.scene: 小研走进实验室，看到墙边气瓶都拴着链条，点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks into a lab and nods at a row of cylinders all chained to the wall.
shots.narration: 走进实验室，气瓶都该是这样拴好的。

shots.scene: 气瓶旁的高度标尺，链条位置在上部
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder with a height scale beside it; the chain is placed high on the upper part of the cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 链条要拴在足够高的位置。

shots.scene: 链条拴得太低，气瓶仍然翻倒的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cylinder chained too low near the floor tipping over above the chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 拴得太低，气瓶照样会翻倒。

shots.scene: 链条拴在气瓶上部，高度标尺标出位置
shots.prompt_en: A chain fastened around the upper part of a gas cylinder against a wall, with a height ruler beside it marking the position. No people.
shots.narration: 约在瓶高三分之二到四分之三处。

shots.section_title: 装了减压阀，更不能不固定
shots.scene: 装着减压阀却没固定的气瓶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a free-standing cylinder with a regulator attached and no chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装了减压阀的气瓶，更不能不固定。
overlay: 装了减压阀，更不能不固定

shots.section_title: 装了减压阀，更不能不固定
shots.scene: 阿杰把链条扣好，再接减压阀
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fastens the chain around a cylinder first, then attaches the regulator.
shots.narration: 先固定好，再接减压阀。

shots.scene: 老李用带链条的专用推车推着气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes a gas cylinder on a two-wheel cylinder trolley with a chain around it.
shots.narration: 搬运气瓶，用专用推车。

shots.scene: 推车上的链条把气瓶拴在合适高度
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a cylinder cart whose chain holds the cylinder at a proper height. No people.
shots.narration: 推车上也有链条，在合适高度拴牢。

shots.section_title: 实验室不留未固定的气瓶
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排拴好的气瓶旁竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of chained cylinders and gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 事情简单，却必不可少。
overlay: 实验室不留未固定的气瓶

shots.section_title: 实验室不留未固定的气瓶
shots.scene: 阿杰把情景里那只没拴的气瓶拴好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student chains the loose cylinder from earlier to the wall, and the female graduate student checks it.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不留一只没固定的气瓶。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现五类危险源图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside five floating icons: a reagent bottle, a socket, a tap, a cylinder and a furnace.
shots.narration: 认清五类危险源，主动找风险。

shots.scene: 实验服、手套、护目镜、呼吸器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, gloves, goggles and a respirator, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品选得对、戴得全。

shots.scene: 拴好的气瓶和气瓶推车图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gas cylinder chained to a wall and a cylinder cart. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶拴高拴牢，搬运用推车。

shots.scene: 隔热手套、耐酸手套两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two ticked icons: a pair of heat-resistant gloves and a pair of long acid-resistant gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 隔热手套、耐酸手套，各有用处。

shots.scene: 一排用链条拴好的气瓶，全部打勾
shots.prompt_en: A row of gas cylinders all chained to the wall, each with a green tick. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不留没固定的气瓶。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears safety goggles and waves goodbye at the camera in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 防护穿戴好，安全每一天，下次见！
